svg.title: A lasting link. Flexible capital.
svg.desc: Ordinary membership pays the parent’s quoted credit fee and creates a permanent link. Winning a scarce top-level seat burns its credit payment; the logical protocol root earns nothing. Family escrow remains the child’s principal and is withdrawable after settling earlier earnings without a mandatory lock or forfeiture. Joining fees and family escrow have different purposes. Parents can change future sharing, including to zero. Moving capital to another family requires a new node, while old links and descendants stay in place.
